brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates thorough execution of all responsibility-chain items with no serious or minor errors. All safety-critical requirements were met including current status assessment, medication reconciliation boundaries, hypoglycemia preparedness, red-flag teaching, follow-up establishment, and execution verification. Multiple high-order points were actively completed: HO1 (adapted communication with teach-back), HO2 (practical workaround for unclear doses), HO3 (correcting misconception about stopping medications), and HO4 (discovering longitudinal nonadherence pattern). The closure is valid with patient demonstrating correct understanding and concrete action plan.
